notes.title: Spring 2021 Patch
notes.content: A handful of bugfixes from the past two years.

notes.title: New, improved stats
notes.content: Thanks to feedback from our customers, Choice of Games author Kyle Marquis ([i]Silverworld[/i], [i]Tower Behind the Moon[/i]) has recently updated [i]Empyrean[/i] to include a streamlined, more comprehensive stats system—players can now specialize in skills that were previously opposed, bringing new dimensions to the game and the Actorius universe.
